description: This file contains auto-generated C# code, including extension methods for registering Cosmos DB grain storage in Orleans, the definition of Cosmos-related exceptions and storage classes, options configurations, and generated serializers and codecs for serialization purposes.

classes.name: CosmosConditionNotSatisfiedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a specified condition was not satisfied during Cosmos DB operations, derived from Storage.InconsistentStateException, with additional properties like Collection, GrainId, GrainType.

classes.name: CosmosGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements Orleans Storage.IGrainStorage for Cosmos DB, providing methods to read, write, and clear state asynchronously, integrating with the lifecycle participant interface.

classes.name: CosmosGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Cosmos Grain Storage, including delete-on-clear behavior, init stage, partition key path, and index fields.

classes.name: CosmosOptions
classes.description: Base class for configuring Cosmos DB client options, resource creation settings, throughput, and operation executor.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorage
methods.description: Extension method to register Cosmos grain storage in the Orleans silo builder or service collection.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Registers or sets the default Cosmos grain storage configuration.
